pictures.name: SS1-Emperor-Rabbi
pictures.prompt: A Roman palace hall in the second century, marble columns, bronze oil lamps, a mosaic floor. the Roman emperor, a bearded man in his forties in a white toga with a purple border and a gold laurel wreath, sits on a carved chair leaning forward in friendly conversation with Rabbi Joshua, an elderly Jewish sage with a long grey beard, in a plain undyed wool robe and a woolen mantle with fringes at its corners, who sits across from him, calm and warm. Golden lamplight, deep blue shadows between the columns. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
